subtitle: Offline Senior Scam Shield
blockedCountSuffix: known scam number entries loaded, fully offline.
monitoringText: Monitoring this call against the local blocklist.
flaggedText: This number has been reported for scam calls. Do not share OTPs, bank details, or make payments.
permissionsHint: Grant these in Android's permission prompts, or in Settings → Apps → SafeVoice, so warnings can appear during a call.
onboardingBody1: SafeVoice quietly checks your incoming calls and warns you if one looks like a scam — all without needing the internet.
onboardingBody2: When someone you don't know calls, SafeVoice turns on the speaker automatically and listens for common scam warning signs. If it hears something suspicious, it will warn you right away.
onboardingBody3: If a caller ever asks you to keep the call a secret, go to a private room, or not tell your family — hang up and call a family member. Do this even if SafeVoice does not show a warning.
familyAlertDescription: If SafeVoice detects a likely scam call, it can send a text message to a family member so they know to check on you.
protectionPausedSpeakerOff: Turn on speakerphone to let SafeVoice keep listening for scam warning signs.
protectionPausedUnavailable: Live scam detection isn't available on this device right now.
